user_observation: Crash 0xC0000005 at save-game load after Korgan L/M/S HD BMP installation.

evidence.diagnosis: Native DrawFlush_GL clears 1024*1064*4 bytes through a 1024x1024 atlas scratch buffer. Installed M portrait height matches the accumulated height at the crash. Direct oversized BMP override path exceeds native scratch capacity.
evidence.additional_risk: NKORGANL height 1243 also exceeds this 1024-high native atlas path; not separately tested.

mitigation.state: All three test overrides removed after installed hashes checked; all were absent before installation.
mitigation.unaffected: Native BIFs, renderer DLL/INI, UI experiments, saves and release untouched.
mitigation.verification: All three test override paths absent after restoration; game and InfinityLoader were closed.

hd_requirement: A renderer path supporting oversized portraits is required to retain L 791x1243 and M 676x1064. Do not reinstall the rejected set through the unmodified native atlas path.
